title: spec: `protocol.zod.ts` cites a bare `ADR-0028` beside `/ai/models`, which is cloud's record (cite it as `cloud ADR-0028`)
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): published copy that cites the wrong registry, measured. `reach:` every reader of `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts` JSDoc on the `GET /api/v1/ai/models` response. `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` also resolves a bare number against this registry, where `ADR-0028` is an unrelated record. The lines are in `packages/spec`, which is `domain:spec` by the lane table.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`. It comes from #24456's dev report (PR #24482, `out_of_scope_findings`), where the spec line was under that claim's hold-off. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's.

## What (read on `origin/main` `e11ae4b6b`)

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3359` reads ``/** `GET /api/v1/ai/models` — the environment's plan-filtered picker list (ADR-0028). */``.
- `protocol.zod.ts:3362` reads "Objects when the service exposes the ADR-0028 allowlist; …".
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts:375` reads "the ADR-0028 allowlist and the bare-id fallback". It is a test comment and ships nothing, but it is the same citation.

## Why it is cloud's record

- This registry's `docs/adr/0028-metadata-naming-and-namespace-isolation.md` is "Metadata Naming & Namespace Isolation". It says nothing about models, plans or a picker.
- `/ai/models` is served by `@objectstack/service-ai`. `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx:75` lists it as "Cloud/EE — not installable".
- The v17.0.0 client changelog entry that introduced `ai.models()` with this citation says `service-ai` is a Cloud/EE package in the `cloud` repo.
- AGENTS.md (about `:258`–`:260`): decisions that draw the open/closed or commercial boundary "are cited from this repo as `cloud ADR-NNNN` — ⛔ never as a bare number". A plan-filtered model list is that boundary.
- Cloud's own `ADR-0028` was not read: this session has no access to `objectstack-ai/cloud`. Its title is unconfirmed, and the reading rests on the facts above.
- PR #24482 qualifies the same citation in the client TSDoc (`packages/client/src/index.ts:6702`), `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx:112` and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:395`. Once it lands, these spec lines are the only places that still cite it bare.

## What done looks like

- The three lines cite `cloud ADR-0028`.
- The change is JSDoc and comments only, with `Clause-②: no`. No describe string, shape or generated file moves; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` stays in sync.
- `CHANGELOG.md` history is left as written.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues` "bare ADR-0028 citation cloud ADR-0028 ai models picker protocol.zod": 5 hits, all closed and about other records (#16927, #14509, #14507, #9072, #5992).
- "cross-repo ADR citation must be qualified cloud ADR prime directive 13 spec describe": the rule's own cards, #14496 and #14509 (both closed). Neither names `ADR-0028`.
- The control query reaches the rule's family (#14496, #14509).
- Dedupe words: spec protocol.zod ai models bare ADR-0028; cloud ADR-0028 model picker allowlist citation.
